title: 记录 AI 问询 5：资料包类型 ai_context、渲染服务与 get_record_context 工具（MCP）
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZSA7o5vcLjQjM1myV

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Source: topic #36996. Key words (maintainer, 2026-11-24 19:17Z, handing the epic to this seat): 「36996 你接手整个专题的任务，现在就开专区派发」.
Grading: area:ai · Feature · p2 (topic child at the epic's level; it blocks rows 7–10) · reach: n/a (new capability) · evidence: read.

> **Amended 2026-11-25** by the maintainer's session (maintainer · os-bob · session_012dn2AecKpLaYkUtNRiqtby), on the maintainer's word 「同意你的建议」. The maintainer accepted ADR-0160 points 1, 2 and 10:
> - point 1 with three conditions;
> - point 2 changed;
> - point 10 as written;
> - and a bound on carried text.
>
> The record is amended in draft PR #37196 (Tier H; the maintainer merges it). Build to #37196 as drafted; once merged, it is the authority. The changes are marked **[amended]** below. They come from the ADR amendment and from an independent review of this card.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：落地「情境包」这个新元数据类型、按提问人权限读记录的渲染服务、`get_record_context` 工具（本仓先上 MCP），以及统一的「这是资料，不是指令」包装。类型和它的读者在同一个 PR 里。
- 谁受益：应用作者能声明「这条记录交给 AI 的是哪些字段、哪些关联列表、哪段正文」；外部 AI 经 MCP 一次调用就拿到；应用内助手（第 9 行）用的是同一个工具。
- 不做会怎样：专题第 7–10 行都在等它；AI 只能自己拼 `describe_object`、`get_record`、`query_records`。
- **[amended]** 某个用户读不了包里的某个关联对象时，省略那一节并说明，不再整包拒绝；多个包被拒时列出「名字（标签）」；关联列表里的长文本受一个总量上限约束，上限按业务证据定。
- 需要你做的：审 #37196（ADR 修订）并合并。

## What

Implements ADR-0160 (`docs/adr/0160-record-scoped-ai-inquiry.md`) D1, D3, D4 and D5, as amended by #37196:

1. **The `ai_context` kind (D1).**
   - Strict schema with the six v1 keys `name`, `label`, `object`, `fields`, `related`, `body`, and bounds on entry counts refused at parse.
   - Registered on every surface D1 lists: a registry row with the `skill` row's flags, the metadata-core enum, the `aiContexts` collection key, a liveness row per key, and a `KIND_COVERAGE` row with an example pack.
   - **[amended]** Author defects are reported by `os validate` in this PR. The at-save half is #37176, which lands before #37143.
   - **[amended]** D1's bound on lookups is not built here. Parse cannot tell a lookup from another field, so lookups are bounded by the field-count bound. This deviates from D1's words. Either the approver accepts it, or #37176 adds a lookup-count rule. State in the PR which applies.
2. **The render service (D3), read as the caller.**
   - Order: objects are judged first, then fields are projected onto the caller's served schema, then the targets of surviving lookups are judged, then the reads run.
   - The field-level rule decides withheld vs not-visible.
   - An unreadable related row is absent. A lookup the caller cannot open carries no id.
   - A long body becomes an outline with anchors.
   - The output is one envelope in three parts (data, notes, framing sentence), built by one function (proposed home `@objectstack/core`).
   - **[amended] Object level (#37196, point 2).**
     - A `related` child the door serves to nobody (the system-object refusal, or API exposure off) refuses the whole call. So does a refused lookup target. Both answer `PERMISSION_DENIED`, naming the object only when the caller's schema shows it.
     - A `related` child that *this caller* is not served (ADR-0106 object-level visibility) is left out. It is never read, never named, and the notes carry the one not-visible statement.
   - **[amended] The bound on carried text (#37196, D3).**
     - Long-text values in related-list cells are allowed. They count toward one total bound together with the body: every long-text cell counts, a long-text field in `fields` included.
     - A cut cell is marked `truncated`, and the notes state every cut.
     - The number is a service constant pinned by test. Choose it against business evidence and name the evidence in the PR: whole-policy answering of about 12,000 tokens measured well in BrightRule (objectstack-ai/brightrule `docs/design-record-scoped-ai.md`). 8,000 characters as the only bound is too low.
3. **`get_record_context` (D4).**
   - I/O is zod in spec beside the dataset tools, projected to JSON Schema, and served by one executor. It runs under `data:read` with `readOnlyHint`.
   - Order of judgement: the root object's gates come before any pack lookup, then pack selection with no fallback.
   - The naming bound applies, with `PERMISSION_DENIED` on every object-level refusal.
   - Optional `McpDataBridge` members and a `#wireBridgeTools` step; the name joins `MCP_DOOR_TOOL_NAMES`.
   - **[amended]** The several-packs refusal lists each candidate as name and `label`, not the machine name alone (#37196, point 1, condition 1; D1 names `label`'s second reader).
4. **The package (D5).** Proposed as `@objectstack/service-record-context` under `packages/services/`. It exports the read-set function, and the executor plans its reads from that function.

Not here:
- the product-registry registration and the `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE` entry (row 9);
- the skill key (row 8);
- the Studio form (row 7);
- the advisory validation reports of #37196 D1 (they land with their readers, rows 8 and 6).

## Acceptance

- The type and its reader land in one PR (ADR-0049). `Metadata-protocol: added`, with its `Skills-docs:` line.
- Tests pin each of these:
  - the order of judgement;
  - **[amended]** a `related` child the door serves to nobody refuses the whole call with `PERMISSION_DENIED`, named only when the caller's schema shows it;
  - **[amended]** a `related` child this caller is not served is left out: never read, never named, and the notes carry the one not-visible statement. This replaces the merged test "a child the caller is not served is refused PERMISSION_DENIED without naming it";
  - a field the served schema hides is not named and yields the one not-visible statement;
  - an exempt caller gets the #35137 withheld naming;
  - an unreadable related row is absent, with no id and no count;
  - an `anchor` that does not resolve is refused with one answer;
  - the executor reads no object outside the exported read set;
  - **[amended]** the several-packs refusal names each candidate with its label;
  - **[amended]** a related long-text cell is carried within the total bound. Past the bound it is cut, marked `truncated`, and stated in the notes. The bound's value and its evidence are named in the PR;
  - **[amended]** text before a long body's first heading is reachable (an outline entry with an anchor) or stated in the notes. It is never silently unreachable (D3: every cut is stated);
  - **[amended]** an `anchor` re-read either carries only the section or states that fields and related lists are re-sent. Choose one and pin it: a 25-section document should not re-send everything 25 times without that being a decision;
  - **[amended]** parity, ADR-0149 D7: pinned here over one stdio bridge under both MCP transports. The real executor over the runtime HTTP bridge is #37175.
- The body bound, the carried-text bound and the related-row cap are service constants, pinned by test.
- **[amended]** One user-facing name. In zh, the kind is 「情境包」 in labels, catalogue entries and executor sentences (today the PR mixes 「AI 上下文包」 and 「资料包」); en stays "context pack".
- **[amended]** ADR-0160: build points 1 and 10 as merged, and point 2 as amended by #37196.

Parent: #36996 (row 5). Reader: the epic's owning seat (repo:cloud#1), which dispatches it.
Related:
- #37196 (ADR-0160 amendment);
- follow-ups cut from #37173's review: #37175 (HTTP-bridge parity), #37176 (at-save author reports), #37178 (outline bound), #37180 (pack naming);
- objectstack-ai/cloud#4969 (narrowing judges this tool by its read set);
- objectstack-ai/cloud#4970.

Dedupe (objectstack, is:issue, open and closed): `get_record_context` 4 (#36996 epic, #36997 ADR closed, #34830 seat post, #37001 no overlap) · `ai_context` 3 (#36996, #36997, #37001) · `"context pack"` 11 (the same three; 8 closed, unrelated).
